note.question: How can usage and stochastically changing capacity inform dynamic pricing of wireless internet?
note.overview: Inspired by new developments in dynamic spectrum access, we study the dynamic pricing of wireless Internet access when demand and capacity (bandwidth) are stochastic. The demand for wireless Internet access has increased enormously. However, the spectrum available to wireless service providers is limited.
